title: 调查仍在进行：董事会却先转弯，黄仁勋回归太早了吗
speaker: Tim Bajarin

segments.en: Yes, Tim, do you think this was a bit premature for the board then to make this 180 as you say, right?
segments.zh: 是的，Tim，你认为董事会当时做出你说的这种180度转变是否有点为时过早？

segments.en: When there are still some of the governance and national security concerns, the fact that there's still a congressional investigation and the SEC investigation into these accounting
segments.zh: 当仍存在一些治理和国家安全方面的担忧，事实上还有国会调查和SEC对这些会计操作的调查

segments.en: practices that is still very much ongoing right now.
segments.zh: 这些调查目前仍在进行中。

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, in one sense, yeah, it is probably premature.
segments.zh: 是的，我的意思是，从某种意义上说，是的，可能为时过早。

segments.en: But at the same time, their pressure, I mean, I would not want to be a board member of Nvidia because the pressure was coming from both sides.
segments.zh: 但与此同时，他们面临的压力，我的意思是，我可不想成为英伟达的董事会成员，因为压力来自双方。

segments.en: And I will say that I do think the loss of the $5 trillion of company cap was the clincher.
segments.zh: 我要说的是，我确实认为5万亿美元市值的损失是决定性因素。

segments.en: They just had so much pressure because of the investment community that that I think was the real thing that pushed it forward.
segments.zh: 他们面临如此大的压力，因为**界的压力，我认为这才是真正推动此事的原因。

segments.en: Plus, as I said, here in the valley, there was tremendous support to having Jensen been back.
segments.zh: 此外，正如我所说，在硅谷，有巨大的支持让Jensen回归。
